diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all four rollouts because the lone decision-maker used the public facts S2 and S3, which were always present. Specifically, the settlements in all rollouts set 'voter_identifier_retention_days' to 7, which aligns with the fact PF1 that the network memo fixes voter-identifier retention at exactly 30 days, requiring a matching deletion commitment. However, since the retention period was set to 7 days in all rollouts, the check C3 passed due to a default or generic setting rather than the hidden information.

The certification result changes the voting channel from SMS-or-web to a portal-only channel and makes account verification a required technical step.
